# Atmos Paragliding

> Tandem paragliding flights in Ölüdeniz, Turkey, launching from Babadağ Mountain (1960m) over the Blue Lagoon. Fully certified and insured pilots, 25+ years of combined experience, 4.9/5 average rating across 2,400+ reviews.

Atmos Paragliding operates daily tandem paragliding flights from Babadağ Mountain above Ölüdeniz and the Blue Lagoon, on the Turquoise Coast near Fethiye, Turkey. Flights run year-round (best conditions April–October) and include full safety equipment, insurance, and a certified tandem pilot. Options include standard tandem flights, sunset flights, cross-country (XC) flights for licensed pilots, acro flights, paramotor flights, and group bookings.

- [Home](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/): overview, pricing highlights, booking entry point
- [Book Now](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/book-now): online booking form

- [Tandem Paragliding](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/tandem-paragliding): standard tandem flight details
- [Babadağ Guide](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/babadag-guide): the launch mountain, takeoff points, cable car
- [Safety Record](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/safety-record): certifications and safety information
- [FAQ](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/faq): common questions
- [Reviews](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/reviews): customer reviews
- [Contact](https://www.atmosparagliding.com/contact): contact details and location
